visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Exterior shot of a traditional Japanese restaurant with a yellow facade and black trim. A vertical wooden sign reads '大川屋' in black ink. A man in a green shirt and khaki shorts stands before dark curtains (noren) marked with white Japanese characters. (2) Close-up focusing on a black metal exhaust vent mounted on the wooden exterior wall. Wisps of grey smoke rise steadily from the vent into the daylight. A white sign with red and black text is visible below. (3) The camera pans over a physical menu featuring high-resolution photos of eel dishes. Prices like 5,500 and 3,850 are clearly printed alongside Japanese descriptions of the sets. (4) Close-up shots of two different eel sets on a dark wooden table. One dish features dark, glossy sauced eel garnished with a green sprig; another set shows pale, grilled eel slices served with white rice, pickles, and a small white teapot. (5) A young girl with long black hair and a white shirt is shown in a medium shot. She uses wooden chopsticks to place a piece of grilled eel and a clump of white rice into her mouth, looking directly at the camera. (6) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a black tank top and a gold ring, holds a piece of pale grilled eel with chopsticks. She gestures towards the food while speaking, with the restaurant's indoor setting and sliding windows behind her. (7) A top-down close-up shows clear liquid being poured from a black lid into a white ceramic bowl containing small pieces of fish liver and herbs. (8) The woman is walking outdoors along a paved road. The lighting is bright and natural. She holds the camera in a selfie perspective, speaking and smiling. A white car and green mountains are visible in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat acoustic guitar BGM with a steady pop beat begins. A female voice speaks with a high-pitched, friendly Mandarin tone, narrating the wait at the restaurant. Background is a clean indoor room tone. (2) Vocal continues at a moderate pace. A metallic latch click is heard as the scene shifts. (3) BGM maintains a bright and cheerful major-key mood. The narrator describes the menu items with increasing excitement and clear articulation. (4) A distinct liquid pouring/splashing sound occurs when soup is served. The music stays consistent in the background. (5) As the setting shifts outdoors, a sudden increase in broad-spectrum white noise occurs, indicating wind hitting the microphone and distant traffic. The female voice remains the primary focus but sounds slightly thinner against the environmental floor. (6) The video concludes with the woman laughing, showing high positive valence and arousal as the guitar BGM fades slightly.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a food recommendation vlog where the creator shares her positive experience at a Japanese eel restaurant. She specifically targets viewers who might be hesitant about eating eel by suggesting the 'Shirayaki' (salt-grilled) style over the traditional sauced version.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a mix of B-roll food shots and on-camera narration to build credibility and maintain engagement. The contrast between indoor dining and outdoor walking segments creates a sense of a completed journey.
